external_test_policy: All 12 Part 3 cells are external test by the user's later decision; this supersedes the earlier 11-Part-3-plus-1-Part-1/2 proposal.

soh.definition: 100 * same-cell Step 4 discharge capacity at the measured RPT / selected same-cell BoL capacity
soh.capacity_unit: native Amphr; absolute unit semantics remain unverified

degradation.source: PyDMA model-derived diagnostics, not independently measured ground truth
degradation.primary_gate: RMSE < 15 mV and at least 3 accepted runs

feature_modalities.discharge: Step 4 voltage curve; same-RPT target-derived capacity features are prohibited
feature_modalities.charge: Protocol-aware charge curve: Step 6 for Parts 1-2, Steps 5+6 for Part 3
feature_modalities.physics: Validated Temp1 features only; preserve missing values and availability masks

preprocessing.external_test_use: final evaluation only; never for fitting, tuning, selection, or early stopping
